scientific.integrity: The result is derived directly from the published DoG and DoWG scalar recurrences under a constant subgradient. The DoG asymptotic follows from a convergent Taylor remainder, while the DoWG geometric law follows from a one-dimensional monotone fixed-point map and local contraction.
limitations: Deterministic one-dimensional convex Lipschitz startup problem.
Only the phase before first reaching the minimizer is classified.
No universal post-hit or stochastic convergence ordering is claimed.
The asymptotic comparison is for increasingly conservative initialization ratio.

title: Exact geometric startup law for DoWG and its separation from DoG
